findings.issue: "algo que este inició" is a little heavy. "algo que había iniciado" would read more smoothly, but the current wording is correct. The meaning is right: the passive "fue detenido" has an outside agent, like the English, and does not suggest the updater stopped itself the way "se detuvo" could. "este" refers clearly to the updater, and "puede que aún esté reemplazando" keeps the uncertainty. The tone is factual and calm, as the safety-clause context asks. "actualizador" and "instalación" match the sibling keys in ui.common.updates. Spelling is correct and "este" correctly has no accent mark under current RAE rules.
